_about: One place for what each platform accepts. The publisher (publisher/publish.py) reads maxSeconds and cutSeconds: a longer video goes to that platform as a cut of its first cutSeconds, with a short fade out. The video build reads notes when it plans a video. Add what we learn about a platform here.

notes: The API refuses Reels over about 40 s on this account (rupload ProcessingFailedError, the container never finishes). Seen 2026-11-16; may lift as the account ages.
So the first 39 s must work alone: hook, the key idea and the payoff before 39 s; the mascot end card is cut.
The grid and feed show an early frame: the headline must be readable from frame 0.
No private or scheduled posts through the API.
Shorts up to 3 minutes; documentaries are 16:9 long-form and are never cut.
Until Google's API audit passes, API uploads stay private.
